messages:
sanjay: starting a small eu-west canary for embed-service v2.18 at 20% traffic. short preflight running, i'll watch SLOs.

deploy-bot: Automated: release=v2.18 stage=canary region=eu-west traffic=20% commit=be2f9a preflight=[metrics,traces,kvcache]

rachel: pulling SLO panels https://dash.redwood.ai/slo/embed-service?region=eu-west&window=10m

ken: eyeballing p95 and p99: p95 jumped from ~95ms -> 380ms; p99 up to ~980ms over last 6m

srebot: ALERT: slo.embed-route.p99 breached (rule=slo-embed-99). routing alert to this channel.

sanjay: freeze ramp at 20% and gather kv/prefix cache stats. do not promote.

rachel: kvcache evictions spiked at 21:12, prefix cache hitrate dropped 66% -> 48% during the interval

ken: traces show a mix of long-context requests routed to quantize-v3 path; a couple of pods GC'ed and returned 502s while reloading weights

ops-runbook: Quick guidance: if p99 > 800ms OR 5xx delta > 0.4% -> hold + pin to last stable. see https://runbooks.redwood.ai/deploys/pause-and-pin

sanjay: let's pin canary shards back to v2.17 to stop the thrash. rachel, can you run the pin?

rachel: running pin now:

```bash
deployctl pin --service embed-service --version v2.17 --scope canary --reason "p99 spike during canary"
```

deploy-bot: Pin request accepted: service=embed-service pin=v2.17 scope=canary. propagation_estimate=22s

srebot: Muting slo-embed-99 alerts for 15m while remediation takes effect. :white_check_mark:

rachel: pin applied. canary routing now pinned to v2.17. kicking off warmpool prefetch + small autoscaler bump to help warm pods.

ken: after prefetch, p99 falling back toward ~200-250ms and p95 trending to ~120ms. 5xx sampling back to baseline.

sanjay: good. holding canary at 20% for 45m for observation, then we'll decide to continue or rollback globally. release note draft: "Canary ramp paused due to transient embed-route latency/p99 spike; canary shards pinned to previous stable (v2.17) pending investigation."

rachel: filing follow-up ticket with traces and cache telemetry: INF-8342. tagging eng-runtime and infra.

deploy-bot: Status update: canary held=20%, pinned=v2.17, alerts muted. closing loop unless fresh signals appear.
